execution_requirement: This standard-library-only exporter also requires the frozen study declaration from the repository or source archive at src/measure_service/benchmarks/reference_data/synthetic-isocratic-ablation-v1.json.

interpretation.analyte_projection: prediction_* fields are copied from retention_prediction.prediction.analytes[*].result; gaussian_* fields are copied only from gaussian_observation.observation.analytes; assessment_* and detection fields are copied only from the stored analytical assessment; historical_utility_input_* fields are copied from consumed raw metrics.
interpretation.failed_and_future_slots: The evaluation status and failure fields remain explicit. No outcome or optimizer reward is fabricated.
interpretation.missing_values: Blank cells mean evidence is unavailable or was not recorded; they are not zero.
interpretation.scope: Synthetic latent chromatographic outcomes; no physical-instrument or manuscript-protocol qualification is implied.
interpretation.stage_boundary: A stored retention prediction remains available when later Gaussian production fails. Prediction-stage values never fill Gaussian-centroid fields, and neither stage alone creates analytical assessment, acceptance, historical utility or optimizer reward.
interpretation.unconsumed_completed_attempts: Available attempt, method, simulator and evidence fields are copied while the evaluation status remains unchanged.
interpretation.utility_and_reward: Historical utility, analytical acceptance and the selected optimizer reward are separate columns.

generator.draw_order: task index, analyte A/B/C, ln_k0 then S1
generator.implementation: Python standard-library random.Random; sequential uniform draws rounded to six decimal places

selection.held_out: two independently generated unfiltered tasks; every draw retained without any separation or optimizer screening
selection.regression: the original two constructed unfiltered tasks, retained without modification

contrasts: noise prior within each optimizer target
each GP arm versus shared random control, labelled jointly changed policies

factors.fixed: scalar SingleTaskGP with public default ARD RBF kernel, inferred Gaussian likelihood, default outcome standardization/input normalization, qLogExpectedImprovement, one candidate, same acquisition optimization budgets and recorded runtime

optimizer_target.confirmed_acceptance_reward: 1 iff an observed immutable analytical assessment is accepted; 0 for observed not_accepted or unknown. This is a lower-bound observed-confirmation reward, not a chemical failure label or calibrated probability. Missing/execution failures are not zero-valued training data.
optimizer_target.historical_utility: existing published finite-resolution-reference BoTier utility, maximize

default.interpretation: reference-default prior observed in public backend before declaration; explicitly supplied to preserve this comparison if later defaults change

surrogate_noise_prior.interpretation: declared inferred-noise regularization stress test; neither prior is measured physical uncertainty or fixed observation noise

preflight.accounting: fabricated component-preflight histories are separate from all600analytical evaluations; retain their calls, warnings and walltime separately
preflight.before_campaigns: each pattern/length under each prior must return a finite feasible genuine model-guided candidate with no random fallback; otherwise retain all planned study outcomes as unknown without running or retuning
preflight.constant_histories: Gaussian regression and qLogEI on binary observed-confirmation rewards are an explicitly misspecified optimization heuristic, not classification or calibrated probability

reporting.failure_handling: retain every planned slot, censored/unknown outcome, complete-attempt versus consumed expenditure and failed proposal timing; no success-only averaging
reporting.initialization: identical coordinates for every arm at each seed; all three evaluations count against every arm budget
success_criteria: strict analytical acceptance with unknown retained
summaries: combined descriptive summary labelled as pooled constructed tasks
